title: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus Mediation by the Disruptive Activity of Environmental Toxicants on Sex Hormone Receptors: In Silico Evaluation.
authors: Iheagwam, Franklyn Nonso; Odiba, Joseph Kelechi; Iheagwam, Olawumi Toyin; Ogunlana, Olubanke Olujoke; Chinedu, Shalom Nwodo
one_liner_zh: 该研究用分子对接和MD模拟评估环境毒物对性激素受体的干扰并关联T2DM，虽涉及蛋白-配体互作和转录因子网络，但核心对象非蛋白质-DNA互作，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: This study investigates the disruptive activity of environmental toxicants on sex hormone receptors mediating type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM). Toxicokinetics, gene target prediction, molecular docking, molecular dynamics, and gene network analysis were applied in silico techniques. From the results, permethrin, perfluorooctanoic acid, dichlorodiphenyltrichloroethane, O-phenylphenol, bisphenol A, and diethylstilbestrol were the active toxic compounds that could modulate androgen (AR) and estrogen-alpha and -beta receptors (ER) to induce T2DM. Early growth response 1 (EGR1), estrogen receptor 1 (ESR1), and tumour protein 63 (TP63) were the major transcription factors, while mitogen-activated protein kinases (MAPK) and cyclin-dependent kinases (CDK) were the major kinases upregulated by these toxicants via interactions with intermediary proteins such as PTEN, AKT1, NfKbeta1, SMAD3 and others in the gene network analysis to mediate T2DM. These toxicants pose a major challenge to public health; hence, monitoring their manufacture, use, and disposal should be enforced. This would ensure reduced interaction between people and these toxic chemicals, thereby reducing the incidence and prevalence of T2DM.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了环境毒物对介导2型糖尿病（T2DM）的性激素受体的干扰活性。采用毒代动力学、基因靶点预测、分子对接、分子动力学及基因网络分析等计算机模拟技术。结果表明，氯菊酯、全氟辛酸、滴滴涕、邻苯基苯酚、双酚A和己烯雌酚是能够调节雄激素受体（AR）及雌激素α和β受体（ER）从而诱导T2DM的活性毒性化合物。早期生长反应因子1（EGR1）、雌激素受体1（ESR1）和肿瘤蛋白63（TP63）是主要转录因子，而丝裂原活化蛋白激酶（MAPK）和细胞周期蛋白依赖性激酶（CDK）是这些毒物通过基因网络分析中与中间蛋白（如PTEN、AKT1、NfKbeta1、SMAD3等）相互作用而上调的主要激酶，从而介导T2DM。这些毒物对公共健康构成重大挑战；因此，应加强对其生产、使用和处置的监管。这将确保减少人们与这些有毒化学物质的接触，从而降低T2DM的发病率和患病率。
